# Bramha Dalvi — Full portfolio context

> Extended reference for LLMs and crawlers. **Start with** [/llms.txt](https://bramha.work/llms.txt) · **Plain-text pages** [/llm/index.txt](https://bramha.work/llm/index.txt)

## How to parse this site

1. Read `https://bramha.work/llms.txt` for a concise overview.
2. Fetch `https://bramha.work/llm/<page>.txt` for any page — plain text extracted from prerendered HTML (no JS/WebGL needed).
3. Use HTML URLs only if plain-text mirrors are unavailable.

## Case study: Guild of Guardians

- URL: https://bramha.work/work/guild-of-guardians
- Mirror: https://bramha.work/llm/guild-of-guardians.txt
- Client: Immutable
- Role: Feature Owner & Lead UX Designer
- Timeline: ~6 months
- Outcomes: +25% D7 retention, +12% D7 LTV on a live mobile RPG
- Themes: data analysis, retention, live ops, AFK rewards, monetization, personas, A/B surveys

## Case study: Rocksmith+

- URL: https://bramha.work/work/rocksmith

- Client: Ubisoft
- Role: UX Lead for Mobile & Multi-platform Interactions
